verdict.description: approve iff there are no high findings and no still_present prior findings

summary.description: 2-3 sentences: what the change does and the overall state of the review

id.description: stable kebab-case slug, reused if the same defect is reported again in a later round

scenario.description: Mandatory for high, in one of two forms. Defect findings: a concrete failure scenario — with state/input X, Y happens instead of Z. Disproportionate-change findings: the smaller change that would work instead, and roughly its size.

fix_hint.description: one-line suggestion of the fix direction; empty string if none

prior_findings_check.description: one entry per ledger finding with status fixed-claimed; empty array when no ledger was provided
